title: Understanding Median
text: To find the median in a sorted list, you need to locate the middle value. Since there are $$719$$ rows, think about how you would find the middle index in this case.

title: Calculating the Middle Index
text: For an odd number of elements, the median is the element at the position $$\frac{n+1}{2}$$. Try applying this formula to find the middle index for $$719$$ elements.
